title: Parallel optical interconnect candidate: common relief, reported models and complete cost limits

reported_status: The available P1 70E52F46 capture specifies a common embossed CYTOP relief, conformal Parylene-C film and late projected two-dimensional route selection, with actual package/process operations. It REPORTS generating ten layouts and running scalar optical/process/cost models; linked HTML, ZIP, images and executable components were NOT collected, so execution/artifact contents are not independently verified here. Reported geometry and body/aperture simulations support a restricted multimode connection candidate, not qualified packaged <=3dB loss or >=90% manufacturing yield. The full conditional ledgers include both actual couplers, packaging, inspection and rejected attempts: $4.13 per working device at assumed90% yield versus $3.73 repeated-panel replication and $4.04 parallel two-photon printing. Those are engineering estimates, not quotes or demonstrated comparator performance for the exact contract. The chosen design does not support a tenfold total-cost saving or a demonstrated missing incumbent capability. Novelty, finished optical performance and production yield remain unestablished. Complete ROOT continuation extends the common-cost threshold to unequal actual yields and clarifies the source model cost partition.
